entries.name: agent-browser
entries.use_for: Give coding agents a fast CLI to drive a headless browser with ref-based snapshots.
entries.why: Vercel Labs' browser CLI for AI agents (~44k stars); compact accessibility snapshots save tokens.

entries.name: Browser Use
entries.use_for: Let an LLM agent operate a real browser to complete web tasks.
entries.why: Most popular AI browser-agent library (118k stars); works with any major LLM.

entries.name: browser-harness
entries.use_for: Let coding agents drive your real logged-in Chrome
entries.why: From the browser-use team: lightweight harness connecting Claude Code/Codex/Cursor to a real Chrome via CDP.

entries.name: Cheerio
entries.use_for: Parse and query HTML with a jQuery-like API in Node.js for scraping.
entries.why: Default HTML parsing library for Node scrapers (~27M weekly npm downloads); fast, no browser needed.

entries.name: chromedp
entries.use_for: Drive Chrome via the DevTools Protocol from Go without external dependencies.
entries.why: Most-used Go library for headless Chrome (~13k stars); pure Go CDP client.

entries.name: Colly
entries.use_for: Write fast scrapers and crawlers in Go.
entries.why: The standard Go scraping framework; simple callback API and high throughput.

entries.name: Crawl4AI
entries.use_for: Crawl websites into clean, LLM-ready Markdown and structured data.
entries.why: Open-source (Apache-2.0) crawler built for RAG and agents, 86k stars; runs fully locally.

entries.name: Crawlee
entries.use_for: Build reliable Node.js crawlers over HTTP, Playwright or Puppeteer with queues and retries.
entries.why: Production crawling toolkit from Apify: request queues, proxy rotation, autoscaling built in.

entries.name: Crawlee for Python
entries.use_for: Build reliable Python crawlers with Playwright or HTTP, queues, retries and storage.
entries.why: Python port of Crawlee with the same production-grade crawling primitives.

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.use_for: Turn websites into LLM-ready Markdown or structured data via an API you can self-host.
entries.why: Widely used scrape/crawl/search API for AI apps; SDKs for many languages (AGPL-3.0 server).

entries.name: jsoup
entries.use_for: Parse, clean and scrape HTML in Java
entries.why: The standard Java HTML parser with CSS selectors and safe-list sanitizing, maintained since 2009.

entries.name: Katana
entries.use_for: Fast web crawling and spidering with headless or standard modes
entries.why: ProjectDiscovery's crawler with JS parsing, scope control and pipeline-friendly output; usable as a Go library.

entries.name: Lightpanda
entries.use_for: Run a lightweight headless browser driven via CDP from Puppeteer or Playwright.
entries.why: Purpose-built headless browser in Zig; much lower memory and faster startup than Chrome (AGPL-3.0).

entries.name: Maxun
entries.use_for: Turn websites into structured APIs with self-hosted robots
entries.why: Self-hostable open-source scraping platform with a recorder, scheduled runs and API output; AGPL-3.0.

entries.name: newspaper3k
entries.use_for: Extract article text, authors and metadata from news pages
entries.why: Widely used Python article extractor and news crawler.

entries.name: Obscura
entries.use_for: Lightweight headless browser for AI agents and scraping
entries.why: Purpose-built headless browser aimed at agent and scraping workloads; ~90 contributors, Apache-2.0.

entries.name: page-agent
entries.use_for: Control a web page's UI with natural language from inside the page
entries.why: Embeddable JS GUI agent from Alibaba that drives web interfaces without a separate browser harness.

entries.name: Playwright CLI
entries.use_for: Drive a real browser from a coding agent with short CLI commands instead of a heavy MCP server.
entries.why: Official Microsoft tool; token-efficient browser automation built for agents, ships its own skills.

entries.name: Puppeteer
entries.use_for: Control headless Chrome or Firefox from Node.js for scraping, screenshots and automation.
entries.why: The original high-level Chrome automation API from the Chrome team; 95k stars.

entries.name: Readability.js
entries.use_for: Extract the main article content from an HTML page, like Firefox Reader View.
entries.why: Mozilla's battle-tested content extractor (~11k stars) used in Firefox Reader View.

entries.name: Rod
entries.use_for: Automate and scrape with Chrome from Go using a high-level, chainable API.
entries.why: High-level Go DevTools driver (~7k stars) with auto-wait, iframe and concurrency support.

entries.name: ScrapeGraphAI
entries.use_for: Extract structured data from websites by describing what you want to an LLM.
entries.why: Popular LLM-powered scraping library (~32k stars); prompt-driven pipelines, local or hosted models.

entries.name: Scrapling
entries.use_for: Scrape sites with adaptive selectors that survive layout changes, from simple fetches to full crawls.
entries.why: Fast-growing (88k stars) adaptive scraper with fast parsing and built-in fetchers; BSD-3.

entries.name: Scrapy
entries.use_for: Build large-scale crawlers and scrapers with spiders, pipelines and middleware.
entries.why: The mature, battle-tested Python crawling framework with a large extension ecosystem.

entries.name: Selenium
entries.use_for: Automate real browsers via WebDriver from Java, Python, JS, C# or Ruby.
entries.why: The original browser automation project (~35k stars); W3C WebDriver standard, Grid for scaling.

entries.name: Skyvern
entries.use_for: Automate browser workflows on unseen sites with LLM and computer-vision agents.
entries.why: AI browser automation (~23k stars, AGPL-3.0) that fills forms and runs flows without per-site selectors.

entries.name: Stagehand
entries.use_for: Mix code and natural-language actions to automate and extract data from websites.
entries.why: Combines deterministic Playwright code with AI act/extract/observe primitives; TS-first.

entries.name: Trafilatura
entries.use_for: Extract main text, metadata and comments from web pages.
entries.why: Top-scoring main-content extractor in benchmarks; Python library and CLI.
